		remove_variable = zg361_pp_t_stage_4_deadline_case
		remove_variable = zg361_pp_t_stage_4_deadline_state
		remove_variable = zg361_pp_t_stage_4_deadline_days
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_t_capacity_hours_authorized value = 10 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_t_capacity_hours_available value = 10 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_t_capacity_hours_reserved value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_t_capacity_hours_settled value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_t_capacity_hours_conserved value = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_t_commitment_capacity_authorized value = 2 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_t_commitment_capacity_available value = 2 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_t_commitment_capacity_reserved value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_t_commitment_capacity_settled value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_t_commitment_capacity_conserved value = 1 }
			# Freeze the delivered result's exact five-tuple and payload.  A live
			# result case, not last_grade or a Boolean "preserved" marker, is authoritative.
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_t_result_owner value = var:zg361_result_case_owner }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_t_result_subject value = this }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_t_result_cycle value = var:zg361_result_cycle_serial }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_t_result_case value = var:zg361_result_case_serial }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_t_result_state value = var:zg361_result_case_state }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_t_frozen_grade value = var:zg361_result_grade }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_t_frozen_reason value = var:zg361_result_grade_reason }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_t_frozen_kpi value = var:zg361_result_kpi_frozen }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_t_frozen_rank value = var:zg361_result_rank_frozen }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_t_frozen_evidence_hash value = { value = var:zg361_result_case_serial multiply = 100 add = var:zg361_pp_t_frozen_reason } }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_t_non_aggravation_ok value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_t_visible_feedback_revision value = 0 }
			root = { set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_portfolio_queue_active value = 1 } }
			zg361_pp_schedule_t_stage_01_effect = yes
			zg361_pp_dispatch_t_stage_01_effect = yes
			set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_runtime_applied value = 1 }
		}
	}
}

zg361_pp_schedule_t_stage_01_effect = {
	zg361_case_kernel_schedule_deadline_effect = {
		OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_t_owner
		SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_t_subject
		CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_t_cycle_serial
		CASE_VAR = zg361_case_t_case_serial
		STATE_VAR = zg361_case_t_state
		ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_t_active
		DEADLINE_OWNER_VAR = zg361_pp_t_stage_1_deadline_owner
		DEADLINE_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_pp_t_stage_1_deadline_subject
		DEADLINE_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_pp_t_stage_1_deadline_cycle
		DEADLINE_CASE_VAR = zg361_pp_t_stage_1_deadline_case
		DEADLINE_STATE_VAR = zg361_pp_t_stage_1_deadline_state
		DEADLINE_DAYS_VAR = zg361_pp_t_stage_1_deadline_days
		DEADLINE_PENDING_VAR = zg361_pp_t_stage_1_deadline_pending
		DEADLINE_EXPIRED_VAR = zg361_pp_t_stage_1_deadline_expired
		TICKET_OWNER = var:zg361_case_t_owner
		TICKET_SUBJECT = this
		TICKET_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_t_cycle_serial
		TICKET_CASE = var:zg361_case_t_case_serial
		TICKET_STATE = 1
		DAYS = 30
		EVENT = zg361pp.4001
	}
}

zg361_pp_dispatch_t_stage_01_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { var:zg361_case_t_owner = { is_ai = yes zg361_is_celestial_liege_trigger = yes } }
		# Owner-authorized second AI exception: background resolver only, no GUI.
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_ai_route value = 1 }
if = { limit = { var:zg361_case_t_owner = { is_at_war = yes } } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_ai_route value = 3 } }
else_if = { limit = { var:zg361_case_t_owner = { OR = { has_trait = arbitrary has_trait = ambitious } } } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_ai_route value = 2 } }
zg361_pp_m146_core_effect = {
	ROUTE = var:zg361_pp_ai_route
	TICKET_OWNER = var:zg361_case_t_owner
	TICKET_SUBJECT = this
	TICKET_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_t_cycle_serial
	TICKET_CASE = var:zg361_case_t_case_serial
	TICKET_STATE = 1
}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_ai_route value = 1 }
if = { limit = { var:zg361_case_t_owner = { is_at_war = yes } } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_ai_route value = 3 } }
else_if = { limit = { var:zg361_case_t_owner = { OR = { has_trait = arbitrary has_trait = ambitious } } } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_ai_route value = 2 } }
zg361_pp_m147_core_effect = {
	ROUTE = var:zg361_pp_ai_route
	TICKET_OWNER = var:zg361_case_t_owner
	TICKET_SUBJECT = this
	TICKET_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_t_cycle_serial
	TICKET_CASE = var:zg361_case_t_case_serial
	TICKET_STATE = 1
}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_ai_route value = 1 }
if = { limit = { var:zg361_case_t_owner = { is_at_war = yes } } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_ai_route value = 3 } }
else_if = { limit = { var:zg361_case_t_owner = { OR = { has_trait = arbitrary has_trait = ambitious } } } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_ai_route value = 2 } }
zg361_pp_m148_core_effect = {
	ROUTE = var:zg361_pp_ai_route
	TICKET_OWNER = var:zg361_case_t_owner
	TICKET_SUBJECT = this
	TICKET_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_t_cycle_serial
	TICKET_CASE = var:zg361_case_t_case_serial
	TICKET_STATE = 1
}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:zg361_case_t_owner = { is_ai = no zg361_is_celestial_liege_trigger = yes } }
		# Exactly one visible decision is queued.  Each option schedules only the
		# next card, so a 46-card popup storm is structurally impossible.
		save_scope_as = zg361_pp_prompt_subject
		var:zg361_case_t_owner = { save_scope_as = zg361_pp_prompt_owner }
		save_scope_value_as = { name = zg361_pp_prompt_cycle value = var:zg361_case_t_cycle_serial }
		save_scope_value_as = { name = zg361_pp_prompt_case value = var:zg361_case_t_case_serial }
		save_scope_value_as = { name = zg361_pp_prompt_state value = 1 }
		save_scope_value_as = { name = zg361_pp_prompt_mechanism value = 146 }
		var:zg361_case_t_owner = { trigger_event = { id = zg361pp.146 days = 1 } }
	}
}

zg361_pp_t_try_advance_01_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
				OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_t_owner
				SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_t_subject
				CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_t_cycle_serial
				CASE_VAR = zg361_case_t_case_serial
				STATE_VAR = zg361_case_t_state
				ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_t_active
				EXPECTED_OWNER = var:zg361_case_t_owner
				EXPECTED_SUBJECT = this
				EXPECTED_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_t_cycle_serial
				EXPECTED_CASE = var:zg361_case_t_case_serial
				EXPECTED_STATE = 1
			}
			var:zg361_pp_m146_consumed = 1
			var:zg361_pp_m147_consumed = 1
			var:zg361_pp_m148_consumed = 1
		}
		zg361_case_t_advance_01_effect = {
			TICKET_OWNER = var:zg361_case_t_owner
			TICKET_SUBJECT = this
			TICKET_CYCLE = var:zg361_case_t_cycle_serial
			TICKET_CASE = var:zg361_case_t_case_serial
		}
		if = { limit = { var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 } zg361_pp_schedule_t_stage_02_effect = yes
			zg361_pp_dispatch_t_stage_02_effect = yes }
	}
}

zg361_pp_t_timeout_stage_01_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { var:zg361_pp_m146_consumed = 0 }
		zg361_pp_m146_core_effect = {
			ROUTE = 3
			TICKET_OWNER = var:zg361_pp_t_stage_1_deadline_owner
			TICKET_SUBJECT = var:zg361_pp_t_stage_1_deadline_subject
			TICKET_CYCLE = var:zg361_pp_t_stage_1_deadline_cycle
			TICKET_CASE = var:zg361_pp_t_stage_1_deadline_case
			TICKET_STATE = var:zg361_pp_t_stage_1_deadline_state
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:zg361_pp_m147_consumed = 0 }
		zg361_pp_m147_core_effect = {
			ROUTE = 3
			TICKET_OWNER = var:zg361_pp_t_stage_1_deadline_owner
			TICKET_SUBJECT = var:zg361_pp_t_stage_1_deadline_subject
			TICKET_CYCLE = var:zg361_pp_t_stage_1_deadline_cycle
			TICKET_CASE = var:zg361_pp_t_stage_1_deadline_case
			TICKET_STATE = var:zg361_pp_t_stage_1_deadline_state
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:zg361_pp_m148_consumed = 0 }
		zg361_pp_m148_core_effect = {
			ROUTE = 3
			TICKET_OWNER = var:zg361_pp_t_stage_1_deadline_owner
			TICKET_SUBJECT = var:zg361_pp_t_stage_1_deadline_subject
			TICKET_CYCLE = var:zg361_pp_t_stage_1_deadline_cycle
			TICKET_CASE = var:zg361_pp_t_stage_1_deadline_case
			TICKET_STATE = var:zg361_pp_t_stage_1_deadline_state
		}
	}
	debug_log = "ZG361PP: exact T stage 1 deadline consumed"
}
